comparison.objective: Raise a loaded stand by two pin holes.
comparison.physical_skill: Transfer load while releasing and reseating two pull pins under unequal assistance.
comparison.success_condition: Stand is level, pins reseated, released for one second, and jolt/speed/force limits respected.
comparison.reason: It is load-bearing dual-pin height adjustment, not torque-preserving screw-stop calibration.
